nodes.name: Match Profile
nodes.notes: Re-joins section data (from Detect Header) with the profiles fetched by Find Sheet Profile. The Airtable search replaces the item, so this restores dataRows/headerCells and attaches columnMap/profileDefaults.

nodes.name: Build Airtable Payload
nodes.notes: Reads offers from Normalize Rows and products from Fetch Products via $('...').all() (the Airtable search replaces the item). Outputs an aggregate toCreate/toReview/exceptions for dry-run inspection.

nodes.name: Has Creates?
nodes.notes: Only create records when there are matched offers. Both branches end at Mark Excel Done so the thread is labelled once per run — after the Airtable write when creates exist.

nodes.name: Expand Offers
nodes.notes: Expands the matched toCreate[] into one flat record item each for Create Offers (autoMapInputData). Emits nothing when there are no matched offers.

parameters.jsCode:
/**
 * n8n Code node — "Build Mapping Prompt" (profile-miss path only)
 * Mode: Run Once for Each Item
 */

const item = $input.item.json;

const TARGET_FIELDS = [
  ['productName',   'REQUIRED. Product/article/description column.'],
  ['brand',         'Brand or producer, if a separate column exists.'],
  ['variant',       'Variant/type qualifier, e.g. "Blue Label", "Extra Dry".'],
  ['category',      'Beer / Spirits / Wine / Soft Drinks / Grocery etc.'],
  ['volumeMl',      'Unit volume. May read 70cl, 0.7L, 700ml.'],
  ['pcsCase',       'Units per case. Often "PCS", "P/C", "units", "x".'],
  ['unitType',      'Bottle / Can / Jar / Pack / Piece.'],
  ['abv',           'Alcohol by volume percentage.'],
  ['originCountry', 'Country of origin.'],
  ['bondStatus',    'Bond/customs status: Bonded, T1, T2, Duty Paid, On Floor.'],
  ['buyPrice',      'REQUIRED. The price WE PAY the supplier. If several price columns exist, choose the supplier/cost price, never a retail or RRP column.'],
  ['currency',      'Currency column, if separate from the price.'],
  ['priceType',     'Whether the price is per case, per bottle, per piece.'],
  ['stockCases',    'Available stock in cases.'],
  ['moq',           'Minimum order quantity.'],
  ['leadTime',      'Lead time / delivery time.'],
  ['eanUnit',       'EAN/barcode for the unit.'],
  ['eanCase',       'EAN/barcode for the case.'],
  ['bbd',           'Best before date / expiry.'],
  ['incoterm',      'EXW / FCA / FOB / CIF / DAP / DDP.'],
  ['warehouse',     'Warehouse or stock location.'],
];

const headerTable = (item.headerCells || [])
  .map((h, i) => `  [${i}] ${h || '(blank)'}`)
  .join('\n');

const sampleTable = (item.sampleRows || [])
  .map((r, i) => `  row ${i + 1}: ${JSON.stringify(r.slice(0, 30))}`)
  .join('\n');

const prompt = `You are mapping a supplier price-list spreadsheet to a fixed schema.

COLUMN HEADERS (index in brackets):
${headerTable}

SAMPLE DATA ROWS:
${sampleTable}

TARGET FIELDS:
${TARGET_FIELDS.map(([k, d]) => `  ${k}: ${d}`).join('\n')}

Return ONLY a single JSON object, no prose, no code fence, no commentary, and
no corrections or second attempts. Your entire output must start with { and end
with }. If you reconsider, output ONLY your final corrected object. Of the form:
{"columnMap": {"productName": 2, "buyPrice": 7}, "defaults": {"currency": "EUR"}, "confidence": "high", "notes": ""}

Rules:
- Values in columnMap are the integer column indices shown above.
- Omit any target field with no corresponding column. Do not guess.
- If a value is constant for the whole sheet rather than a column (e.g. the
  currency appears only in the header text), put it in "defaults" instead.
- productName and buyPrice are required. If either cannot be identified with
  confidence, set "confidence" to "low" and explain in "notes".
- Where several columns could be the price, prefer the one we pay the supplier.
  Never map a retail, RRP, or client-facing price to buyPrice.`;

return { json: { ...item, mappingPrompt: prompt } };
